label: Weaker turbulence: observed NGC 1705 F814W template through the simulated 1.65 µm PSFs; relative flux per numerical cell, no added noise

policy.evaluation: real FFT of both arrays zero-padded to [480, 480] >= [467, 467] samples (no wraparound); template transform reused for every kernel
policy.kernel_origin: the kernel sample at exactly zero angle on both actual axes
policy.template_lattice: the template samples lie on the kernel lattice (same step, exact zero sample); the template extends beyond the kernel window
policy.context: every output sample in the native window receives the complete contribution of all template samples within the kernel extent
policy.output_axes: theta_T[0] + theta_P[0] + m * delta for full index m
policy.crop: full-output samples whose angles equal the native PSF grid, matched from coordinates
policy.boundary: zero outside both arrays (the template is cut at its own edge, beyond the kernel reach of the window)
policy.renormalization: none (no peak, cropped-sum or per-image normalization)
policy.rounding: FFT rounding leaves values of order 1e-17 relative where the exact result is zero or tiny
policy.spatial_invariance: one on-axis PSF assumed throughout the compact field (illustrative)

response: I_k = T (*) P_k with T ~ R (*) (O * H_HST + n_HST): the output keeps Hubble's effective response and noise, the cell response R once, and adds the simulated PSF P_k

parents.binding: kernel files re-hashed against the case record; mean kernels equal the binary observation's parent arrays

sampled.sampling: all 1000 instantaneous PSF pairs are convolved and kept at full precision; the page shows the displayed subset (frames k = 0, 8, 16, ..., 992 and the last frame 999 (126 actual recorded frames, including 0, 200 and 999); every 8th frame keeps the active site within the 30 MiB budget, while all 1000 frames remain in the numerical archives, the scalar records and the 800-frame means)

mean.kernels: the complete 800-frame means (mean_psf_*, frames 200-999), not an average of the displayed samples
mean.linearity: for the fixed template, T (*) mean PSF equals the mean of the 800 per-frame observations under the linear imaging model; the display stretch is applied afterwards

uncorrected.kernel: mean_psfs.npz mean_psf_uncorrected (field atmosphere_opd_m (zero-DM optical counterfactual); equal-weight mean of frames 200-999)

corrected.kernel: mean_psfs.npz mean_psf_corrected (field pre_update_residual_opd_m; equal-weight mean of frames 200-999)

window.orientation: north up, east left (+x west, +y north on the template's projection plane)

saturation_envelope_box_cells.definition: template cells touching the conservative saturation envelope (flags dilated by one mosaic pixel); an enlarged marker, not the exact saturated extent

window.note: the observation crop is declared separately from the PSF panels' 64 x 64 crop; the native window (156 cells, about 8.7 arcsec) is recorded in the flux accounting and the template extends to 312 cells for convolution context

display.raster: PNG row 0 is the north (+y) edge; columns increase towards the west (+x)

derived_arrays.location: outputs/ao_explorer_galaxy/ngc1705-f814w-2m1000-s624-c7241e4190d5-gda93ed5af026/weaker-turbulence/ (full-precision native-window arrays; outside the site and Git)

Member references are re-expressed to resolve to the original files in place. One mean-mode limitation sentence is reworded so that it no longer asserts non-convergence.
